researched.description: Digital textbook and courseware delivery platform for colleges, universities, and school districts
researched.notes: Founding year not stated on the company site; third-party profiles report 2013 (some say 2014), so year_founded omitted. Site redirects www.bibliu.com to bibliu.com.

researched.description: Donor research, engagement, and stewardship software for university advancement offices and nonprofits
researched.notes: Now bundles DonorSearch, ThankView, and Pledgemine and markets to nonprofits generally as well as higher ed advancement; if the owner treats broad nonprofit fundraising software as horizontal (the Blackbaud line), this is worth a second look

researched.description: Tuition payment plans, billing, cashiering, and payment processing software for colleges and universities
researched.notes: Business unit of Nelnet, Inc. (Nelnet Business Services); site claims 25+ years serving higher ed but states no founding year, so omitted

researched.description: Source-to-pay eProcurement, contract, and invoice software for universities, government agencies, and healthcare
researched.notes: Higher education is the anchor vertical but they also sell to local government, utilities, and healthcare; majority growth investment from Accel-KKR

researched.description: Direct-to-adopter pet rehoming platform that animal shelters and municipal animal services agencies offer residents to divert owner surrenders
researched.notes: Candidate had no URL; found home-home.org by search. Site is a JavaScript app whose About page returns no server-rendered text, so I could not confirm whether the operator is a for-profit company or a nonprofit, nor its HQ or founding year (a Facebook listing says Ponderay, ID - not confirmed on the site, so omitted). Confirmed as the right entity by the branded shelter deployments at King County Regional Animal Services and LA Animal Services.

researched.description: Fixed asset tracking software, barcode hardware, and physical inventory services sold across government, education, healthcare, and corporate clients
researched.notes: Horizontal asset-tracking vendor (Ingenium cloud and AssetWIN on-prem) with a mixed software-plus-services model; public sector is one named market among many, alongside Fortune 500 clients

researched.description: Billing, revenue management, payments, and customer engagement software for telecom, utilities, and other high-volume billers
researched.notes: Horizontal enterprise billing vendor - telecom is the core market, government is one listed industry. Site announces completed acquisition by NEC and Netcracker. Founded 1982 as a First Data division; 1994 is when it became CSG Systems International.

researched.description: Bill payment processing, lockbox, and integrated receivables for utilities, insurers, telecoms, healthcare, and government billers
researched.notes: Wholly-owned subsidiary of Busey Bank; horizontal payments processor where government/municipalities is one of six named verticals

researched.description: ACH direct deposit, payroll payments, and electronic payroll document delivery for employers of any size
researched.notes: Horizontal third-party ACH processor serving 318,000+ clients across all industries; no public sector specialization on the site

researched.description: Enterprise ERP, finance, HR, and supply chain software for organizations in every industry
researched.notes: Big-enterprise horizontal ERP; sap.com returned 403 to WebFetch, confirmed founding year via curl with a Chrome user agent

researched.description: AI workflow software for public records and FOIA requests, meeting agendas, and custom processes at cities and counties
researched.notes: Team page lists offices in Los Angeles, San Francisco, and Portland with no stated headquarters, so hq_location omitted; no founding year published. Named customers include Peachtree Corners GA, Saratoga CA, and Los Gatos CA.

researched.description: No-code workflow software for employee leave, accommodations, workplace incidents, and claims at large employers
researched.notes: Horizontal HR/risk workflow product - government is one of roughly fifteen industries listed alongside manufacturing, retail, and hospitality. Operates as an offering of Venforce, Inc.; founding year 2013 is from third-party company databases (the legal entity was incorporated in 2015) and is not stated on the site.

researched.description: K-12 school district software for child nutrition, ERP finance and payroll, and family payments
researched.notes: Formerly EMS LINQ; also sells state-level nutrition systems to state education agencies

researched.description: School nutrition software for menu planning, production, inventory, point of sale, and eligibility at K-12 districts and state agencies
researched.notes: Candidate listed as "SchoolCafe + PrimeroEdge" - both are brands of Cybersoft Technologies, Inc. (founded 1998, Houston); SchoolCafe is the parent-facing menu, application, and payment portal. Canonical product/brand name is PrimeroEdge.

researched.description: Capital planning, program, and construction management software for transportation departments, cities, counties, and water utilities
researched.notes: Candidate had no URL; aurigo.com confirmed. Masterworks spans all capital programs (transportation, water, facilities) and they also sell to private infrastructure owners such as datacenters and life sciences - category picked as Streets because state DOTs and county public works are the flagship market, but Fleet & Asset Mgmt is a defensible alternative.

researched.description: Cloud legal practice management, billing, and document software for law firms
researched.notes: Exhibited at the municipal attorneys' conference, but the stated target market is solo practitioners and small-to-midsize private law firms - government legal departments are a slice, not the primary buyer. Real product company, so flagging for the owner rather than calling it govtech. Legal entity Themis Solutions Inc.; clio.com returns 403 to both WebFetch and curl, so details come from Clio's own blog/about pages via search.

researched.description: Closed-loop referral and care coordination software for community care hubs, area agencies on aging, and community-based organizations
researched.notes: Legal entity is Cumulus Care Inc. (confirmed in a license string embedded in the site). No HQ or founding year published on the site, including the team and contact pages, so both omitted. Buyers are a mix of public agencies (AAAs, state and regional networks) and nonprofit CBOs.

researched.description: AI report writing and field supervision assistant for probation, parole, and pretrial agencies
researched.notes: HQ and founding year come from a third-party company database, not the company site (cognisen.com/about returns 404 and no address appears in the footer) - worth confirming. Listed partner of the Chief Probation Officers of California.

researched.description: AI assistant that drafts case notes, builds case plans, and schedules field visits for community supervision agencies
researched.notes: Operated by String Inc. per its terms of service; the site is a short demo-request page with no address, team, or founding date, so hq_location and year_founded omitted. Distinct from the unrelated casebase.ai portfolio-management product. Listed on the Chief Probation Officers of California site, which corroborates the exhibitor.

researched.description: Customer information and billing software for municipal, cooperative, and investor-owned electric, water, and gas utilities
researched.notes: Candidate had no URL; advancedutility.com confirmed (product is CIS Infinity). A division of N. Harris Computer Corporation. Founding year 1997 is from company boilerplate carried in third-party listings, not the current site. Note the sector map has no billing/CIS category under Utilities & Energy - Grid & Energy is the closest fit and I used it for all four utility-billing vendors in this batch.

researched.description: Utility billing and customer information software for small and mid-size municipal water, sewer, and multi-service utilities
researched.notes: Legal name Continental Utility Solutions, Inc.; the site brands as CUSI and says "nearly four decades" without a year - 1984 comes from the company's own third-party profiles. Serves 1,150+ utilities.

researched.description: Utility billing and customer information software for small and mid-size municipal utilities
researched.notes: Business unit of N. Harris Computer Systems (Constellation Software), which acquired the platform in 2004; founding year 1976 is from the company's own history page. HQ Tyler, TX is from third-party profiles, not stated on the site.

researched.description: Customer information, billing, and mobile workforce software for public power, water, and gas utilities
researched.notes: Owned by Harris Computer Systems, a Constellation Software subsidiary; NorthStar was Harris's original business unit. Sibling company to Advanced Utility Systems and inHANCE in this same batch - all three are Harris-owned CIS vendors.

researched.description: Pump station control and optimization analytics for municipal water and wastewater utilities
researched.notes: Products are Tagger, Dynamic Pump Optimizer, and Lift Station Guardian; founding year 2010 is from third-party profiles, not the site

researched.description: Vendor-agnostic digital operations and analytics platform for drinking water, wastewater, and water resource utilities
researched.notes: Judgment call worth a second look: Xylem Vue is a genuine software/analytics platform (a Xylem and Idrica partnership), but the parent Xylem plc is primarily a water equipment manufacturer - if the owner cards parents rather than product lines, Xylem itself reads closer to supplier. HQ is Xylem plc's (Washington, DC); no founding year for the Vue brand is published, and Xylem plc itself was spun out of ITT in 2011, so year_founded omitted rather than guessed.

researched.description: CAMA mass appraisal, property tax billing and collection, appeals, and assessment analytics software for county assessors and tax offices
researched.notes: Legal name Farragut Systems, Inc.; product family is Arist (CAMA, GIS, Appeals, Analytics) and they run the statewide NCPTS system for North Carolina counties. Site claims 30+ years but states no founding year, so omitted. They also sell a workers' compensation line to insurance carriers - a secondary, non-government market.

researched.description: Pension, unemployment insurance, paid family leave, and workforce program administration systems for state government agencies
researched.notes: Products are Neospin (pension), Neosurance (UI/PFML/disability), WorkforceNXT, HealConnect, and Neotrient, all on their Xelence platform. Categorized under Workforce & Labor because UI and labor agencies are the NASWA-facing business, but the pension administration line would sit under General Gov / HR & Workforce. Registered address is Little Canada, MN in the Saint Paul metro.

researched.description: Cloud data warehouse and AI platform for enterprises in every industry
researched.notes: Horizontal big-data platform with ~12,000 customers across financial services, healthcare, retail, and manufacturing; public sector is one vertical go-to-market. Snowflake's own about page does not state HQ or founding year - both are from widely reported public filings/coverage.

researched.description: AI chat, messaging, and live agent customer service software (INSIDE) for retailers, councils, and universities
researched.notes: Horizontal customer-service product - the marquee references are luxury retail (Versace, Valentino, Dolce & Gabbana, L'Oreal) with government/councils listed as one of eight industries. Founded in Melbourne, Australia in 2001 and moved US operations to Beverly Hills in 2012; founding year is from third-party profiles (one source says 2004) and is not on the site.

researched.description: Community engagement and stakeholder relationship management platform for councils, transportation agencies, and infrastructure project owners
researched.notes: New unified brand combining the Social Pinpoint and Consultation Manager products; dual headquarters in Vancouver, BC and Brisbane, Australia (I recorded Vancouver). No founding year published for the Open Point entity, so omitted. Resources and mining is a listed secondary industry alongside government and transportation.
